name: Feature 01 - Learn to play Zone WARHAMMER 40,000
booth: Feature 01 - Learn to play Zone WARHAMMER 40,000
description: Our team will teach you to play one of the most popular tabletop games of them all

name: Feature 02 - GUNPLA Workshop
description: Build your free Gundam model and take it home. Help is on hand from the pro’s at Zombster

name: Feature 03 - Airbrush Workshop
description: The Airbrush workshop is where you can get up close & really learn the basics of airbrushing Gundam & other models.

name: Feature 04 - SMS Scale Model Competition
description: A showcase of some of the best modellers in QLD. Don’t forget to vote for your favourite entry. Admire and take photos but please don’t touch.

name: Feature 05 - Info Booth & First Aid
description: Info Booth & First Aid. Register for competitions, redeem prizes & enter the Ultimate Christmas Hamper raffle.

name: Feature 06 - Star Trek's 60th Anniversary
description: Help us celebrate Star Trek's 60th Anniversary with Star Trek builds from the community! The MakR Gallery is a showcase of non-competition work and builds from the community including all creative mediums.

name: Feature 07 - Guest Artist Signing
description: Guest Artist Signing - Meet Comic & Illustrator creators. Get items signed and see what’s coming next.

name: Feature 08 - Digital Photobooth!
description: Digital Photobooth! Let the AI digitally transport you to another world or convert you into something amazing! Free photos sent directly to your device! Don’t forget to share on socials #ghmxperience

name: Feature 09 - Brick Build Play Zone
description: Enjoy 100’s of thousands of brick pieces to create your very own creations.

name: Feature 10 - Learn to play with Vault Games
booth: Feature 10 - Learn to play with Vault Games
description: The team from Vault Games will teach you the basics of various games all weekend. Dungeons & Dragons, Magic the Gathering & Neuroscape. Tables are complete with scenery & everything you need to get started. Make sure you register first using the QR code or at the Vault Games stand. Prizes and giveaways all weekend just for trying it out!

name: Feature 11 - The Trading Card Zone by Vault Games
booth: Feature 11 - The Trading Card Zone by Vault Games
description: The Trading Card Zone by Vault Games - Make sure you’ve pre-registered online or at the stand. See the full list of tournament games on the app or by scanning the QR code

name: Feature 12 - Stage Central
description: Stage Central - Our workshop, Q&A and panel hub. Check the full program on the event guide or the App

name: Feature 13 - Free Make & Take Model Kits from Tweed Valley Modellers
booth: Feature 13 - Free Make & Take Model Kits from Tweed Valley Modellers
description: Free Make & Take Model Kits from Tweed Valley Modellers

name: Feature 14 - Vallejo Miniature Painting Workshop
description: Vallejo Miniature Painting Workshop - Learn the basics of painting. All participants get to keep their painted masterpieces! Thanks to YKS Miniatures

name: Feature 15 - The Ibis Brush
description: The Ibis Brush - Brisbane's Premiere Miniature Display Painting Competion brought to you by the Brisbane Display Painters Guild

name: Feature 16 - Cartell Boardgame Zone
description: Cartell Boardgame Zone - Everyone is welcome and entry is free. Register at the Cartell Games stand to find your ultimate boardgame challenge!

name: Feature 17 - Regulation Station
description: Regulation Station is a designated space designed to help individuals manage and regulate their sensory experiences. Also known as a calm or sensory corner, this space provides a supportive environment to pause, reflect, and engage in activities that promote emotional balance and self-regulation. Trained staff from Just Support will be in attendance to assist attendees with their specific sensory needs.

name: Feature 18 - Esports Zone
description: Esports Zone - Freeplay gaming consoles all weekend and retro tournaments

name: Feature 19 - The Kyber Order
description: The Kyber Order - Learn to swing a light sabre just like they do in the movies!

name: Feature 20 - Beyblades Tournament Zone
description: Beyblades Tournament Zone. Register for the official tournament or freeplay. The team will teach you if its your first time battling

name: Feature 21 - RC Zone
description: Pick up a control and race one of the mini RC Cars on the micro track! See the incredible RC trucks and eqipment on display

name: Feature 22 - 501st Legion
description: 501st Legion - Snap a photo opportunity at the ultimate Star Wars fan zone with authentic costumed characters all in the name of charity

name: Feature 23 - LAN Legacy Lounge
description: Get ready to game like it’s 1999! Dive back into the golden age of PC gaming and LAN vibes with classics like Quake III Arena, Unreal Tournament, Red Alert 2 and more!

name: Feature 24 - Cosplay Consuls and championship judges
booth: Feature 24 - Cosplay Consuls and championship judges
description: Meet our experienced Cosplay Consuls and championship judges. Ask questions and get handy tips for your next cosplay

name: Feature 25 - Comic Book Heroes Cosplay X Stage
booth: Feature 25 - Comic Book Heroes Cosplay X Stage
description: Comic Book Heroes Cosplay X Stage - Cheer on our cosplayers as they take to the stage and see other cosplay related panels here. Check the full program on the event guide or the App

name: Feature 26 - Cosplay Studio
description: Cosplay Studio - Includes Cosplay X Registration, Cosplay Repair, Photo Area & Change Room. Free refreshments for all cosplayers.
